comment: Copy this file to config.json and customize for your environment
comment_project: Most project-specific values (launchpad_project, triages_output_dir, repos) are loaded from project.json. Only override them here if you need agent-specific values different from the global project config.
comment_defaults: The following values are automatically set from project.json if not specified here:
comment_launchpad_project: launchpad_project: Defaults to PROJECT.launchpad from project.json

notifications.comment: Set enabled=true and copy notifications.sample.json to notifications.json in the repo root

feedback.comment: post_to_launchpad: post the triage report as a comment on the Launchpad bug. Requires OAuth 1.0a credentials.

context.comment: Context files are read before each AI call. Learnings are appended after notable outcomes.
